This issue is a gadget, which means it needs a second bug to be exploitable. The advisory says axios reads inherited data in the bodyless aliases, axios.get, axios.delete, axios.head and axios.options, before it normalizes the config. If Object.prototype already carries a data property, axios sends it as a body on requests that set none. Two more paths exist for code that calls low level adapters or helpers directly with plain config objects. Inherited proxy or paramsSerializer values could route a request through a proxy or change URL serialization. The advisory says these do not reproduce through normal axios calls on 1.15.2 and later.
